arc_sunday.speaker: Frank
arc_sunday.text: You let me finish at the bay. I'll sit in the back. That is not a yes for next week.

arc_sunday_pushed.speaker: Frank
arc_sunday_pushed.text: You brought Sunday into the bay again. I came anyway. Don't spend it.

forgive_heard.speaker: Frank
forgive_heard.text: You did not say his name. I noticed. I will think about next week. That is not a yes.

forgive_invited.speaker: Frank
forgive_invited.text: You asked me here, then preached forgiveness. I can sit with one of those. Not both in the same morning.

forgive_sat.speaker: Frank
forgive_sat.text: Forgiveness is a long word for a back pew. I stayed to the end. That is the whole report.

listened.speaker: Frank
listened.text: I came because you listened on Thursday, not because of the sermon. Do not spend that.

invited.speaker: Frank
invited.text: You asked for Sunday. I came. The bay opens at eight tomorrow.

back.speaker: Frank
back.text: I took a seat in the back. Do not put me on a committee.
